description: How leads are scored: fit and activity rules, Hot/Warm thresholds and engagement decay.

fields.description: Score leads and update their heat.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Rewrite links in emails sent from a lead or deal so clicks are recorded. Opens are tracked by the Email Account's Track Email Status.
fields.label: Track Email Clicks

fields.description: Lead sources (one per line) that mean the lead submitted a form; their creation counts as a Form Submission.
fields.label: Website Lead Sources

fields.description: Hot: engagement and fit both at or above their Hot thresholds. Warm: engagement or fit at or above its Warm threshold. Cold: everything else.
fields.label: Heat

fields.description: Every activity's points halve after this many days.
fields.label: Engagement Half-Life (Days)

fields.description: The lead's Heat Score is this share of fit plus the rest of engagement.
fields.label: Fit Share of Score

fields.description: Who the lead is. Fields are CRM Lead field names (comma-separated: any of them), or $business_email, $email_bounced, $unsubscribed. Rules with the same Group give only their best match.
fields.label: Fit Rules

fields.description: What the lead does. Points decay with the half-life. Page View rules with Path Patterns (e.g. contact, *-migration) apply to those pages instead of the plain Page View rule.
fields.label: Activity Rules

name: CRM Heat Settings
